customers_email_length.name: customers_email_length
customers_email_length.value: "customers"."email" is null or char_length("customers"."email") between 3 and 320

customers_phone_length.name: customers_phone_length
customers_phone_length.value: "customers"."phone" is null or char_length("customers"."phone") between 3 and 32

customers_company_length.name: customers_company_length
customers_company_length.value: "customers"."company" is null or char_length("customers"."company") between 1 and 160

organization_invitations_terminal_state.name: organization_invitations_terminal_state
organization_invitations_terminal_state.value: not ("organization_invitations"."accepted_at" is not null and "organization_invitations"."revoked_at" is not null)

profiles_full_name_length.name: profiles_full_name_length
profiles_full_name_length.value: "profiles"."full_name" is null or char_length("profiles"."full_name") between 1 and 100
